## 4. Featured Software Projects
### CampusTrace — Lost & Found Web Application
- **Problem**: Campus communities lose valuable items without a centralized, verified system to track and claim lost belongings.
- **Solution**: Developed a full-stack MERN application providing secure item reporting, verified claim requests, and administrative mediation.
- **Technologies**: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Cloudinary.
- **Key Features**: Cloudinary image uploads, claim verification workflow, role-based admin moderation hub, dual-theme glassmorphic design.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MihisaraNet/CampusTrace

### StudyNova — Smart Student Study Planner App
- **Problem**: University students struggle to balance module workloads, revision routines, and academic deadlines.
- **Solution**: Built a cross-platform mobile productivity application backed by a secure Spring Boot micro-backend.
- **Technologies**: React Native, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Spring Security, Expo, Zustand.
- **Key Features**: Daily study routine tracking, interactive revision charts, exam countdowns, cloud sync.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MihisaraNet/StudyNova

### LayerForge 3D — Custom 3D Printing Marketplace (Ceylon-3D)
- **Problem**: Makers and clients lack a streamlined system to submit custom 3D models and calculate material costs online.
- **Solution**: Created an online service platform featuring automated 3D file pricing calculators, material selections, and order status dashboards.
- **Technologies**: React Native, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Expo, JWT.
- **Key Features**: 3D STL file upload support, material selection (PLA/ABS/Resin), automated price quoting, admin order tracker.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MihisaraNet/Ceylon-3D
- **Live Demo**: https://layerforge3d.vercel.app

### MediCare — Enterprise Pharmacy Management System
- **Problem**: Community pharmacies face stock stockouts, financial losses due to untracked drug expiry dates, and slow manual counter sales.
- **Solution**: Built an enterprise pharmacy management platform providing automated batch expiry tracking, low-stock threshold alerts, and role-based staff authorization.
- **Technologies**: Spring Boot 3, React, Vite, MySQL, JWT, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
- **Key Features**: Batch expiry monitoring, automated low-stock warnings, role-based access control, transactional billing.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MihisaraNet/Pharmacy-Management-System

### RentalX — Vehicle Rental Management System
- **Problem**: Automating fleet bookings and contract schedules while maintaining clean Object-Oriented software architecture.
- **Solution**: Designed an N-tier vehicle rental management system applying strict Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, custom sorting, and file persistence.
- **Technologies**: Spring Boot, Java 21, OOP, JavaScript, REST API.
- **Key Features**: Vehicle fleet catalog, automated rate calculation, reservation scheduling, client-side dynamic search.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MihisaraNet/RentalX
